topology_note: R1 (S0/0/0 = 10.10.99.1/30) connects to R2 (S0/0/0 = 10.10.99.2/30). R2 connects to the branch at 192.168.1.0/24 via Gi0/0. Static routes are used.
expected_fault: Static route to 192.168.1.0/24 on R1 points to next-hop 10.10.99.5, which does not exist on the serial link (the valid peer is 10.10.99.2). The link being up is confirmed but the next-hop is unreachable.
